note: Adapted from Emerson's 1925 original description (in English), placed in the subgenus Nasutitermes (Nasutitermes); based on many alates, males, queens and numerous soldiers from 10 colonies at Kartabo, British Guiana, and specimens from 1 colony at Dunoon; type locality Kartabo. The soldier head width and hind tibia measurements are damaged in the scanned text and are not listed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to N. longirostratus as described by Holmgren (1910), but smaller in all measurements; soldier head length 1.16—1.24 mm, separated in the key from the group with head length over 1.34 mm. Nasus dark brown, slender and rather long; the anterior margin of the soldier pronotum is not concave and bears only a fringe of very short hairs, with no bristles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown (slightly paler in the queen), oval, covered with hairs and a few bristles; fontanelle rather large and distinct, forked at the tip. Antennae paler than the head, 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 slightly shorter but wider than segment 3. Eyes medium-sized, rather prominent, nearer the lower margin of the head; ocelli medium-sized, slightly less than their own length from the eyes. Labrum paler than the head; postclypeus paler than the head, with a median line. Pronotum almost as dark as the head, covered with hairs and a few longer bristles; sides slightly rounded, posterior margin nearly straight or rounded, very rarely slightly concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanota broadly concave, the corners rather sharp. Wings rather dark, smoke-coloured, a pale stripe visible between the media and the cubitus, especially near the base. Abdominal tergites almost as dark as the head. Measurements: length with wings 9.00—9.60 mm; length without wings 5.00—6.00 mm; head length 0.96—1.06 mm; head width 0.86—0.93 mm; antennal length 1.61—1.70 mm; eye diameter 0.26—0.29 mm; pronotum length 0.45—0.46 mm; pronotum width 0.74—0.77 mm; hind tibia length 1.06—1.09 mm; fore wing length 6.85—7.45 mm; fore wing width 2.01—2.13 mm; queen length 11.00 mm; male length 4.50 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, oval, the lateral outline slightly elevated at the base of the nasus; 4 bristles at the base of the nasus and 2 on the vertex. Antennae pale yellow, 13-segmented, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Mandibles with a distinct point. Nasus dark brown, slender and rather long. Thorax pale yellow; anterior margin of the pronotum with a fringe of very short hairs, without bristles, not concave. Legs pale yellow. Abdomen pale yellow; tergites covered with microscopic hairs, each with a row of bristles at the posterior margin. Measurements: total length 3.00—3.50 mm; head length 1.16—1.24 mm; antennal length 1.36—1.45 mm; pronotum width 0.32—0.38 mm.
